def code_challenge_method_plain(verifier, challenge):
    """
    If the "code_challenge_method" from `Section 4.3`_ was "plain", the
    received "code_verifier" is compared directly to the "code_challenge".

    .. _`Section 4.3`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7636#section-4.3
